title: Fix private cluster: stale encrypted metadata causes RBAC drift and audit suppression
creator: Asha Patel
description: Summary: Several Private (VPC/on-prem) customers reported rolebinding inconsistencies and missing audit events after a series of scheduled KMS rotations. Root cause appears to be a race where tenant encrypted metadata fails to unwrap during key rotation, producing a nil metadata object that downstream RBAC reconciler treats as 'no bindings' and the audit emitter drops events due to missing context headers. This ticket tracks the urgent patch, rollout, and postmortem for affected clusters.
reproduction_steps: 1) Deploy private cluster with KMS rotation enabled and two active keys (old/new)
2) Trigger controlled rotation while simultaneous rolebinding sync occurs (observed with heavy reconciler load)
3) Observe unwrap failures in keystore logs: 'envelope unwrap error: key version not found' followed by RBAC reconciler applying empty binding set
4) Audit pipeline logs show suppressed events with 'missing-context' and no requeue into backfill queue
observed_evidence: keystore logs: /var/log/redwood/keystore.log lines 2103-2119 show KMS UnwrapError and backoff attempts
rbac reconciler trace: trace-id=tr_9f2e; reconciler applied 0 bindings for tenant 'nb-corp' while expected 12
console dashboard spike: console.redwood.internal/dashboards/priv-audit?range=1h shows 78% drop in audit event rate during rotation window
mitigation_applied: Hot rollback of recent KMS key roll for impacted clusters (performed by infra team) to restore unwrap path
Enabled temporary compat unwrap that falls back to previous key for 24h: config flag kms.unwrap_fallback=true
Contacted customers with remediation steps and ETA for patch deployment
proposed_fix_summary: Implement atomic unwrap-with-backoff and explicit metadata integrity checks. If unwrap fails, reconciler will abort apply and enqueue audit placeholder event. Add synchronous rewrap job that attempts to re-encrypt using active key and mark tenant metadata for reconciliation. Harden keystore client to surface unwrap errors to audit pipeline and to avoid 'empty binding' semantic.
implementation_notes: Add unwrapWithBackoff(ctx, envelope) in keystore client (golang) with jittered retries up to 10s total
Change RBAC reconciler: treat nil metadata as transient error and requeue tenant instead of applying empty set
Audit emitter: emit 'audit-placeholder' with tenant id and enqueued flag when context missing; add reingest hook to backfill events once metadata available
Add unit+integration tests simulating key rotation and ensuring no application of empty bindings
Coordination: will require DB migration flag tenant_metadata.rewrap_pending boolean and a migration to backfill for affected tenants
acceptance_criteria: Keystore unwrap errors do not result in immediate RBAC 'clear' operations under rotation load
Audit event rate remains within 95% of baseline during a controlled rotation test
E2E test: simulate rotation with heavy reconciler load, assert no tenant lost bindings and placeholder events are emitted for any transient failures
Patch rolled to 3 affected private clusters in staging and then to production via canary rollout without SLA breaches
rollout_plan: 1) Merge hotfix PR and run full CI: GH PR #14258
2) Deploy to staging-private-1; run synthetic rotation test and ensure metrics stable
3) Canary to private-prod-canary (10% of tenants) for 2 hours with increased monitoring
4) Full rollout to remaining private clusters in 4 waves with 30m observation windows
5) Post-rollout: trigger backfill rewrap job and verify audit reingestion via console dashboard
